newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for bids for contractor.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for bids for contractor.

text.p: The Egyptian state said on Monday it was extending until October 21 the deadline for bids for 450,000 shares, or 90 percent, of the contracting firm Nasr Public Utilities and Installation.
The state holding company National for Construction and Development wants to sell the shares to one or more strategic investors and the original deadline was September 21.
It said it decided to extend the deadline "in response to the request of applicants and to give them enough time to cover the high demand to buy".
The holding company said in August that bids should be for at least 50,000 shares, or 10 percent of the equity.
The offer is part of the government's privatisation programme, which has accelerated dramatically in recent months.
